recentItems.title: India’s Deadly Katar Punches Through Two Sheets of Metal (S1, E4) | Full Episode | Forged in Fire
recentItems.description:
Four bladesmiths face the challenge of forging signature blades using the hata technique, combining multiple layers of steel into one billet. After a brutal wood chop and sharpness test eliminates one competitor, the final two smiths head home to recreate the Katar.

The Katar is a punching and thrusting weapon originating from Southeast Asia. Used by the fearsome Rajput warriors of India, this distinctive H-shaped handle places a large triangular blade directly over the wearer's clenched fist. Warriors would hunt tigers with a pair of katars to prove their skill, bravery, and nobility. With $10,000 on the line, which bladesmith will forge the deadliest punching blade and claim the Forged in Fire championship?
 
#ForgedInFire

recentItems.title: Medieval Crusader Swords Take On Punishing Strength Tests (S1, E5) | Full Episode | Forged in Fire
recentItems.description:
Four bladesmiths face the challenge of forging signature blades with a hamon line from W2 steel. After a brutal wood chop and tomato slice test eliminates one competitor, the final two smiths head home to recreate the Crusader Sword.

The Crusader Sword was the European knight's weapon of choice during the Middle Ages as they conquered the Holy Land. This single-handed, double-edged long sword tapered to a deadly point, making it ideal for piercing emerging plate armor. From the legendary Excalibur to the Knights Templar, this iconic blade has been immortalized in films like Kingdom of Heaven and Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. With $10,000 on the line, which bladesmith will forge the deadliest Crusader blade and claim the Forged in Fire championship?

#ForgedInFire
